articles.abstract_en: We study efficient resolution of partnership disputes in which, departing from the partnership dissolution literature, dissolution need not be efficient. We characterize which disputes can be resolved efficiently under both one‐ and two‐sided private information, and show that unless a partnership is sufficiently ineffective, efficient resolution is impossible. We propose simple dispute‐resolution procedures implementing the efficient outcome whenever possible. Finally, we characterize second‐best mechanisms when efficient resolution is impossible and private information is one sided.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究合伙纠纷的高效解决，与合伙解散文献不同，解散不一定是高效的。我们刻画了在单边和双边私人信息下哪些纠纷可以高效解决，并表明除非合伙关系足够低效，否则高效解决是不可能的。我们提出了在可能的情况下实现高效结果的简单纠纷解决程序。最后，我们刻画了当高效解决不可能且私人信息为单边时的次优机制。

articles.abstract_en: A monopolist sells an object characterized by multiple attributes. A buyer can be one of many types, differing in their willingness to pay for each attribute. The seller can provide arbitrary attribute information in the form of a statistical experiment. To screen different types, the seller offers a menu of options that specify information prices, experiments, and object prices. I characterize revenue‐maximizing menus. All experiments belong to a class of linear disclosure rules. An optimal menu may be nondiscriminatory. The analysis highlights the importance of demand microstructure and the benefits of information control in trade settings.
articles.abstract_cn: 一个垄断者销售一个具有多种属性的物品。买方可以是多种类型之一，他们对每种属性的支付意愿各不相同。卖方可以以统计实验的形式提供任意的属性信息。为了区分不同类型的买方，卖方提供一个选项菜单，其中规定了信息价格、实验和物品价格。我刻画了收入最大化的菜单。所有实验都属于一类线性披露规则。最优菜单可能是非歧视性的。分析强调了需求微观结构的重要性以及信息控制在交易环境中的益处。

articles.title_en: Health insurance menu design for large employers
articles.title_cn: 大型雇主的健康保险菜单设计
articles.abstract_en: We provide a framework for large employers designing a menu of health plan offerings that differ on both financial and nonfinancial dimensions. Using administrative data from Harvard University, we estimate a model of plan choice and utilization, and evaluate the benefits of cost sharing and plan variety. For this population of consumers, and a single plan with a generous out‐of‐pocket maximum and zero deductible, modest cost sharing of approximately 30% maximizes average employee surplus. Gains from offering choice are meaningful only if financial differentiation is paired with differentiation along other dimensions where consumer preferences are correlated with efficient coverage levels.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们为大型雇主设计一套在财务和非财务维度上有所不同的健康保险计划菜单提供了一个框架。利用哈佛大学的行政数据，我们估计了一个计划选择和利用模型，并评估了成本分摊和计划多样性的收益。对于这一消费者群体，以及一个具有慷慨的自付上限和零免赔额的单一计划，约30%的适度成本分摊使平均员工剩余最大化。只有当财务差异化与其他维度上的差异化相结合，且消费者偏好与有效覆盖水平相关时，提供选择的收益才有意义。

articles.title_en: Data‐enabled learning, network effects, and competitive advantage
articles.title_cn: 数据驱动的学习、网络效应与竞争优势
articles.abstract_en: We model dynamic competition between firms which improve their products through learning from customer data, either by pooling different customers' data (across‐user learning) or by learning from repeated usage of the same customers (within‐user learning). We show how a firm's competitive advantage is affected by the shape of firms' learning functions, asymmetries between their learning functions, the extent of data accumulation, and customer beliefs. We also explore how public policies toward data sharing, user privacy, and killer data acquisitions affect competitive dynamics and efficiency. Finally, we show conditions under which a consumer coordination problem arises endogenously from data‐enabled learning.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了企业间动态竞争模型，企业通过客户数据学习来改进产品，既可以通过汇集不同客户的数据（跨用户学习），也可以通过重复使用同一客户的数据（用户内学习）进行学习。我们展示了企业的竞争优势如何受到企业学习函数形状、学习函数之间的不对称性、数据积累程度以及客户信念的影响。我们还探讨了关于数据共享、用户隐私和杀手级数据收购的公共政策如何影响竞争动态和效率。最后，我们给出了数据驱动的学习内生地产生消费者协调问题的条件。

articles.title_en: Advantageous selection with intermediaries: a study of GSE‐securitized mortgage loans
articles.title_cn: 中介机构下的有利选择：对GSE证券化抵押贷款的研究
articles.abstract_en: This research studies the effects of mortgage subsidies and asymmetric information in the US mortgage market. I exploit discontinuities in interest rates generated by pricing rules and find patterns consistent with advantageous selection. I estimate an industry model that highlights the relationship between mortgage subsidies, intermediary lenders' incentives, and borrowers' advantageous selection. The model shows that mortgage subsidies enable advantageous selection, creating a deadweight loss of $7.90 billion. The counterfactual analysis reveals that pricing borrowers' private information eliminates advantageous selection only if mortgages are not subsidized. Without the mortgage subsidy, pricing borrowers' private information improves efficiency by $728.58 million.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了美国抵押贷款市场中抵押补贴与信息不对称的影响。我利用定价规则产生的利率不连续性，发现了与有利选择相一致的模式。我估计了一个行业模型，该模型强调了抵押补贴、中介贷款机构激励与借款人有利选择之间的关系。模型显示，抵押补贴促成了有利选择，造成了7.90亿美元的净损失。反事实分析揭示，仅在抵押贷款未获补贴的情况下，对借款人私人信息定价才能消除有利选择。若无抵押补贴，对借款人私人信息定价可提高效率728.58亿美元。

articles.title_en: The effect of privacy regulation on the data industry: empirical evidence from GDPR
articles.title_cn: 隐私监管对数据产业的影响：来自GDPR的经验证据
articles.abstract_en: Utilizing a novel dataset from an online travel intermediary, we study the effects of the EU's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). The opt‐in requirement of GDPR resulted in a 12.5% drop in the intermediary‐observed consumers, but the remaining consumers are trackable for a longer period of time. Our findings imply that privacy‐conscious consumers exert privacy externalities on opt‐in consumers, making them more predictable. Consistent with this finding, the average value of the remaining consumers to advertisers has increased, offsetting some of the losses from consumer opt‐outs.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用一家在线旅游中介的新数据集，我们研究了欧盟《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）的影响。GDPR的选择加入要求导致中介观察到的消费者数量下降了12.5%，但剩余的消费者可被追踪的时间更长。我们的研究结果表明，注重隐私的消费者对选择加入的消费者施加了隐私外部性，使他们更可预测。与这一发现一致，剩余消费者对广告商的平均价值有所增加，部分抵消了消费者选择退出带来的损失。
